highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.150.4 corrects glyph-atlas reuse and shared stencil tracking.
highlights_body: Windows HarfBuzz native assets also stop triggering the BinSkim BA2007 disabled-warnings error.

bullets.detail: Partial glyph updates no longer mark earlier evicted glyphs current. Shared stencil-clear bounds are tracked in native coordinates across differing surface origins.

bullets.lead: Windows HarfBuzz binaries pass BinSkim BA2007
bullets.detail: Consumers no longer need to baseline the disabled-critical-warnings error in libHarfBuzzSharp.dll. The native exports and shaping behavior are unchanged; other existing BinSkim warnings are unaffected.

harfbuzz_summary: The Windows native library now passes BinSkim BA2007 by scoping vendored-source warning suppression. The bundled HarfBuzz engine and exported ABI are unchanged.

v4.150.4.headline: SkiaSharp 4.150.4 corrects glyph-atlas reuse and shared stencil tracking.
v4.150.4.body: Windows HarfBuzz native assets also stop triggering the BinSkim BA2007 disabled-warnings error.
